notes.title: City Game Studio leaves Early Access!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In 2017, City Game Studio marked the beginning of my first adventure as an independent developer. Released in 2019, after approximately 2 years of development, several playtests, a closed alpha and many hours of work, it was a worldwide success... actually a complete success for me who had just launched my first game on Steam.

And you all were amazing. So many of you have supported me, clearly it helped me to continue the development until now. Quite honestly it's been hard to keep working on the same project for so many years, 4 years altogether.

Initially, City Game Studio's development was supposed to end in 2020, so after 3 years of development it should have left the early access. However, an unexpected intervention from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8onxZN7CdUw]one of the pillars of the French Twitch game community[/url] came up. As a result of this much welcomed event, sales went up and the community grew spontaneously, [url=https://www.jeuxvideo.com/news/1210810/la-gestion-de-studio-de-jeux-video-un-sous-genre-a-part-entiere.htm]this resulted in a significant positive effect[/url] on City Game Studio. I would like to thank Domingo and the team that works with him.

This happened a year ago, and today I'm proud (relieved too?!) to announce that City Game Studio is finally fully released!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hcRDBdvtuVQ

[h4]What is coming now?[/h4]
v1.1.1 is already in the pipeline, and I hope to continue working on City Game Studio until the [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-i18n/projects/2]TODO list[/url] is empty. It should take me a few more months.

[h4]Alright, so what happens next?[/h4]
Honestly I wish I could tell that I will publish another game, or that I will continue to work on City Game Studio, or that there will be free DLC, but at this point I don't know.

[h4]And then?[/h4]
I don't know how to project myself for more than 6 months, but I can tell you that I'm not done making games and that the next one might surprise you (and please you it would be nice anyway).

Thanks for reading and for being there,
I wish you a great day
Binogure

notes.title: City Game Studio, biggest update v1.1!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you are as excited as I'm to see the release of City Game Studio just around the corner. 
So without further ado I bring you the most recent features that come with the v1.1!

[h2]A terminal to cheat[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/886453991972f3d05dec61738ee9d311302cc20c.gif[/img]
I think this is the most eagerly awaited feature. Cheating. You have to press [b]F1[/b], this opens a console. You can either click on the underlined texts or type them directly into the console. We begin with the [i]help[/i] command, which lists the available commands. Next, use [i]list-models[/i] to list the modifiable elements of the game. To get more information about a particular element, type [i]help fanbase[/i] to get help for the element [i]fanbase[/i] (this is only an example).

[h2]Market research[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/88000ac1af622cce245c096c1fc1dbc45d1dc2d8.gif[/img]
Marketing managers help you to better master a game genre or a game console. Given a certain investment of time and money, you get crucial information to create better games. 

Just imagine what you could do if you were able to train your employees as well? Oh well, you don't have to be imaginative anymore because it is already possible to train your employees
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/000e19178d0911d6fdc609a7f75b3ee84f4628ac.gif[/img]

[h2]Train your employees to perfection[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/a6abf5ec22e5e8694a6e61fe7bbc84103684dd5f.gif[/img]
Prior to training employees you need a large financial budget to build a university that will house classrooms dedicated to the training of potential prodigies. Naturally this makes City Game Studio much easier, so this feature requires a lot of funding.

In short, as soon as the university is built, select the workers to train, type and duration of the training session, after 2 minutes it's done.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/e8337c051329e189cabc539a4554e4fc231b9842.gif[/img]

[h2]Shop overhaul to furnish studios[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/52879f70d7313b3adca2ce11092f0a509db9db77.gif[/img]
Interface has been enhanced to provide a more fun and accessible way to buy and furnish studios. For example, furnishing a sudio is easier because the furniture list is still displayed while placing the furniture. Also, there is a category system that is easier to navigate.

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/e11699226dfa0b1299a7617162ffe2f2c356ca08.gif[/img]
When you open City Game Studio for the first time you can be somewhat surprised. The game wants to be intuitive and easy to understand. Yet there was a little something missing, almost nothing, but here it is now. Tooltips that explain what's happenning, how to do things, or what to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/f2a98e56149dfa47406855708fdc784e3d8bd8b2.gif[/img]
There are also other small changes that consist in adding links between panels. Instead of having to search opening different menus, you can switch from one menu to another if menus are linked together. For example by clicking on a human resources manager you can access the employee schedule. Or by clicking on an employee you can access the training panel. This will make you feel more comfortable and easier to navigate in City Game Studio, I'm sure.

That's it, this update is huge and contains a lot of additions, so I made it as simple as possible. If you want to know more about it, I invite you to read the [b]Changelog[/b] which is below.

Have a great weekend,
Binogure xoxo

notes.title: Version 1.0!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is it, we're in business. [url=https://www.city-game-studio.com/]City Game Studio[/url] is moving to version 1. For you who are just discovering City Game Studio you need to know that the journey began on 2019 when [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/726840/announcements/detail/3688915287543046985]v0.12.0[/url] was launched on Feb 21st.

Since then, City Game Studio has been showcased at prestigious events such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/726840/view/5277612140655335154]Montreal ComicCon 2019[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/726840/view/1594761646562072877]DreamHack 2019[/url]. All of this happened thanks to the Gameplay Space which helped me organizing playtest sessions, attending many conferences and other social events.

All those events made it possible for City Game Studio to reach maturity and indirectly to release version 1. But before speaking about the future of the game, first let's have a look at the content of this update.

[h1]Console overhaul[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/80116aaa0740602645556c19f532fa28ec8d8077.gif[/img]
Creating a console is quite intuitive, but selling a console is a challenging task. The algorithm which calculates the sales of consoles has been completely revised, even if there are still tweaks to do, it is much more pleasant to build your own console now. Moreover you can manage a marketing campaign dedicated to your console. Be careful though, because a successful console can put you out of business if its selling price is lower than its manufacturing costs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/fedf864e747cdba020e728f22acfda05fd8dfd88.gif[/img]
To inform you about the latest news, a new notification appears. It is about new components available for game consoles design. It includes a short message, with an image of the component concerned.

[h1]Interface revision[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/4122aa6372b00e9170e9dc7ccb72c4cde413d94c.gif[/img]
There is much to say about it. Firstly, the 1983 krash is really hard on you. So I made things a bit more clear by adding useful information to the post-mortems. Apart from that, I've added color codes and tooltips to distinguish the profitable consoles from the others. On top of that, I added an algorithm that automatically selects the profitable consoles instead of the ones that are affected by the crash of 1983. These welcome changes will help you publish profitable games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/f125789b3ce2482d55b7d46a89f9f9bed1d0fb37.gif[/img]
Post-mortems are important, and their content is even more important because it helps you understand how to make good games. That's why game reports also make a brief statement when you don't use all the capabilities of a console. Handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/8fcb3748eccb19ff13b69f8f4766db558e4efe2a.gif[/img]
Since 2019, City Game Studio's interface has been revamped 3 times. Yet one panel had never been redone until today. This panel was the summary of the sales of a game when a game is withdrawn from the market. City Game Studio being a management game, I decided to put some statistics and accounting details. I hope you will like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/747420ecf8dcd7d806cca14a3d113868532723df.gif[/img]
Many of you have been asking for it, and for a while already. It took me a while to set it up properly but you can browse your old creations while you develop new games. It's really convenient as it helps to better adjust the gauges when making games.

[h1]Miscellaneous changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/df400c63295d9ad9849fc4e81a80872816a1d9d6.gif[/img]
When you create your first console you like to publish many games to it. In order to make it more accessible, you can have several publishing offers at the same time. All it takes is a ton of money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/9b9e5af01a40d77d782a0faef4b452a805253760.gif[/img]
Many of you have also asked for this change. Being able to port a game to multiple consoles at the same time. So instead, I've implemented a system that lets you create a game port list. Gone are the long moments of selecting one by one the game consoles, now in a few clicks you can port your games across as many compatible and available platforms as you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/c7dd70a398dde2ec0a3b1a6d2d3911bcc37827b1.gif[/img]
One last change, minor this time. It consists in adding a basement to the city map. It took me 5 minutes to do and I like the effect.

[h1]Closing words[/h1]
I really hope that you enjoy this update, at least I had a lot of fun and I'm not hiding it from you, I also had to work hard on some features.

The [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-i18n/projects/1]first version is complete[/url], and I' ve already started to work [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-i18n/projects/2]on the second one[/url]. The real question is when do I stop working on updates?
I honestly don't know. I have another project in mind. For the moment I focus on City Game Studio while working on this new project on the side.

That's all for today, see you soon on the networks.
[url=https://twitter.com/binogure]Twitter[/url] - [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Binogurestudio]Youtube[/url] - [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/citygamestudio/]Reddit[/url] - [url=https://discord.com/invite/citygamestudio]Discord[/url]

Sincerely
Binogure

notes.title: Fresh clean build
notes.content:
Hey,

Another really small update for the default version of City Game Studio.
This time it is a fresh build of City Game Studio without any delta build. It leads to a faster and a more stable verson.
[h2]Steam beta branch[/h2]
Meanwhile, I'm still working on the upcoming version, which is the v1.0.
The more I work on it, the more I keep adding new features. Feel free to try it out already on the unstable steam branch. The unstable Steam branch is the bleeding edge version of City Game Studio.
If you want to play the very latest version of the game, follow these steps:

[list][*] Go to your Steam Library
[*] Right-click on City Game Studio and select "Properties"
[*] Go to the tab marked "Betas"
[*] In the drop-down box, select "unstable"
[*] Wait for the game to finish updating, you should see the branch name listed after the game name.[/list]
[h2]Saves[/h2]
Most of the time, the save from your main game will work in the Beta Branch. But a beta branch save won't work on the main branch unless those branches are synced.

[h2]v1.0[/h2]
While I plan to release the v1.0 in few weeks I think City Game Studio will remain in Early Access for a couple of months. There are a lot of marketing materials to produce, but I'm running out of time and won't be able to produce everything by the end of April. What does it mean exactly? The v1.0 is still planned for end of april, but the v1.1 will be delayed a bit (I'm gonna try to make another bet August 2021).

Thank you for reading
Regards
Binogure

notes.title: City Game Studio: v0.34.1
notes.content:
Hey folks,

I've been busy reading your feedbacks and working on the very next update. However, I also receive few bug reports, so this update is about fixing them all while improving a bit of the UI (it is a very light update).

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

First of, I want to thank you all, because you sent me a lot of suggestions about how to improve the console manufacturing and also how to improve the game overall.

[h3]Console manufacturing[/h3]
The next update will be the [b]v1.0.0[/b], and I plan to implement the mod support for console manufacturing. You will be able to design your own console cases and import them thanks to mods. I think this is really important because you will be able to make [b]your[/b] dream console.

Currently, it misses an end of life panel for custom platforms. I think it would be better to have a panel that shows some basic information like: unit sold, catalog size, refund rate... Also, I plan to add a notification to announce when a new component is available. Because currently you have to check from time to time to see if there is a new component.

Besides that, you will be able to hire an other studio while you are working on your console, so they are going to make games for your console. You will be able to spend 1 million for 2 games, 5 millions for 10 games or 50 millions for 100 games (I'm still balancing that part atm). So you will have a great catalog for your console when you release it.

Some of you requested the ability to see all the games that have been published on your console, and it is coming, I'm working on it right now. It is not hard to do, but it takes time to do.

I plan to work on other improvements, I don't want to spoil anyone, so I'm going to keep that part secret until its release.

That's all for today, I hope you will enjoy that tiny update
Regards
Binogure

notes.title: City Game Studio: Make your own consoles
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for joining us, for purchasing and playing at City Game Studio. Thanks because it's been two years now since I can work full time on City Game Studio, thanks because it's been two years since many of you have been coming to play and sharing your ideas and suggestions.

I'm not going to go through all the features that have been added over the last two years, you probably already know them. However, I'm going to tell you about the many new features that come with [b]v0.34.0[/b].

[h2]When is v1.0.0, and the end of early access?[/h2]
I know you're all wondering when v1.0.0.0 will be released? Well it's coming soon, and to give you more details, here is the list of stuff I have to finish before releasing v1.0.0.
[list][*] Mod Support: Add/rename component for custom platforms
[*] Custom platform: Add a discontinue panel
[*] Custom platform: Add a notification when a new component is available
[*] Digital store: Rework the feature panel
[*] Game creation: Add a button to see previous game mades (same genre)
[*] Competitors: Add the ability for a competitor to buys out other competitors[/list]

[h3]So what happens next?[/h3]
Once these features are implemented, City Game Studio will leave the early access and I still publish updates [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-i18n/projects]to add new features[/url]. Game support is going to continue for months and after that it depends greatly on the outcome of its official release.

Back to the matter at hand and let's talk about v0.34.0 in detail.

[h2]Let's create game consoles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/624f16cd7803fc26e874a6f915082dd73e017c57.gif[/img]
This is a feature that wasn't planned in City Game Studio, but considering your enthusiasm, I had no choice but to include support for video game consoles. Frankly, I thought it would make the gameplay cumbersome and boring to play because it would make the game too complicated, but you guys were right. Making consoles is a good way to enhance the gameplay, once the 2000's are reached, making your own console and popularizing it becomes a huge exercise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/07194ee04b58af0e5996203664bb3acf35503ae1.gif[/img]
In designing a console, you have to first select the type of console, whether it's a handheld or a home console. Next, you have to carefully choose the electronic components that make it up to customize its case, choose its color and pick the controllers that come with it. Finally, you can determine the price of the console in proportion to its manufacturing cost, which is greatly influenced by the design quality of the console. To maximize revenue while minimizing costs, use an accountant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/06c2d407bedced00ea2491354e42340c47710b4b.gif[/img]
When the console is ready, you still have to wait, because you should develop a dozen of games for the console to meet its public. And then maybe you'll hit the holy grail with a console that reaches 5% market share so that your competitors begin to publish games on your console.

[h3]What happens if you fail to launch your console?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/703eef9cb91c5496bef8f31add51404f5a92e9be.gif[/img]
There are marketing tools available, you can arrange sales, or drop the price of your console. Since the price of the console has a great influence on buyers, selling a console at a discount at first might be a good idea if you want to appeal to competitors.

[h2]Revamping the digital store[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/f0e76e42d26942f669bfd33860b13ecba5c85207.gif[/img]
The old panel was dull and colorless, with the addition of the consoles the time came to dust it off. Of course you will be able to publish games on the consoles you make via the digital store, both features are compatible. Just imagine the possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/7dd1d2932dc55a589501d1183642e93ec1c135fe.gif[/img]
Make your own digital store, make it Skilight compatible and also compatible on your game consoles.

[h3]Server load[/h3]
The server load calculation algorithm has been extensively revised. With a dozen servers you can already support nearly a million users. No more bankruptcy because of the digital store!

[h2]Additional changes[/h2]
Difficulties have all been revised and corrected, it goes from very easy to a mode that is really hard. Obviously there's a whole world between these difficulties, and I'd advise you to start with the lowest difficulty in order to understand the inner workings of City Game Studio.

Important notifications are shown immediately so that you don't miss them. That means when someone applies for a job, or when there's a salary increase or a crash in the video game market, notification appears. You still have the possibility to flag it as spam, so this type of notification is not displayed anymore.

There are a lot of other changes, a lot of fixes, I suggest you either read the complete changelog at the end of this announcement, or you can directly enjoy this update by launching City Game Studio, be aware that it will be a real change for you!

Good day to all of you!
Binogure

notes.title: City Game Studio: Convention rework
notes.content:
Hello,

You were expecting v0.32.4 and not v0.33.0. Well I am sorry if I disappointed you but this update is way to big so I had to call it v0.33.0!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/6a6d397f1cfc41f61d534666d4d4edb9beee293a.gif[/img]

City Game Studio is more challenging. But interviews are there to help you get through it better.
I want to make it clear that any resemblance with real characters is completely fortuitous.

Many things have changed in the game, and it will continue to do so. In the next version, [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-i18n/projects/1]v0.34.0[/url], you will be able to make your own game console.

notes.title: City Game Studio: Mod support
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm glad to see you for this new update, which I hope you'll like as much as I do! There is a lot of content, and good content, let's have a look at it together!

[h2]Mods support[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/be32b7b0285fe43c71f8699293a03542c9273889.gif[/img]
You have read correctly, you can create mods for City Game Studio. There are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/726840/workshop/]already a lot of them[/url] and you can already use them! That's really great.

For those of you who want to create your own mod, I've set up a tool that should make it easy for you. I call it [url=https://modmaker.city-game-studio.com/]the ModMaker[/url], it allows you to create mods by filling out a form. For those who are more code-oriented, you can also create mods based on [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-mod-maker/blob/master/doc/README.md]the documentation[/url].

Mod support allows you to add and rename consoles, console manufacturers, indie companies and competitors. It also allows you to add new translations, new difficulties, new game speeds, new maps or new themes.

[h2]New consoles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/1c1b54b7aeb87c7e24e3c3d19ab8de1f176a3015.gif[/img]
It's 2020, this wonderful year brings us a lot of new consoles. You will see appearing the Gamestation 5 of Deny as well as the VBox Series V of Minisoft. The most recent consoles have been adjusted with more recent data (which allows us to have a more balanced market share).

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/fd9b555da639dcdd0865462311d19e86bf86564a.gif[/img]
That's not all, I've also added JPG format support for logos, and also a better interface to navigate through the files. The game porting panel now gives you information on platform compatibility, which will help you know if porting will be profitable or not. Other improvements include being able to select all the features of a game engine at the time of its creation or being able to reduce all the details of the games on sale with a single click.

[h2]The final word[/h2]
I haven't detailed all the features, improvements, optimizations and fixes here, but you can find them in the detail of changes (a little below). Be aware that there are many of them and that City Game Studio should better support big games (with more than 1000 employees).

Regarding Mods support, a version v0.32.1 is in preparation, and it will contain interesting features.

In short, I don't say more, I wish you an excellent game, enjoy this update, and see you soon for the next one!

xoxo
Binogure

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Steam workshop
notes.content:
Hello folks,

Since I haven't published anything for about a month now, I though it would be great to give you an update about the [b]Mod Support[/b]! I'm really excited about it! So let's talk about the technical challenges implied by this feature!

[h2]Steam API[/h2]
Sadly, there was no [u]working[/u] Godot Engine library that supports the Steam Workshop. 
So I [url=https://github.com/Gramps/GodotSteam]forked the most used[/url] and [url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/GodotSteam]implemented the steam workshop[/url].
Feel free to use it, but since it needs a 64 bits supports, you might want to use the [url=https://github.com/xsellier/godot]custom version[/url] of Godot Engine I made. Since Godot Engine is free and open source, everybody has access to its source code, which is really convenient!

[h2]GDScript integration[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/cb620aa0c5b1c154bf5d89c2514a4864983a224a.gif[/img]
[url=https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/getting_started/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_basics.html]What is GDScript?[/url]
Now the Steam API is exposed to GDScript, I started implementing the Steam Workshop in [b]City Game Studio[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/79d314e1b4707ad4c335693337f024422048e94a.png[/img]
I spent several weeks designing a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite-state_machine]state machine[/url] that returns human readable error messages.
[code]func get_error_description(error_code):
  if error_code == E_RESULT_OK:
    return 'Success.'
  if error_code == E_RESULT_FAIL:
    return 'Generic failure.'
  if error_code == E_RESULT_NOCONNECTION:
    return 'Your Steam client doesn\'t have a connection to the back-end.'
  if error_code == E_RESULT_INVALIDPASSWORD:
    return 'Password/ticket is invalid.'
  if error_code == E_RESULT_LOGGEDINELSEWHERE:
    return 'The user is logged in elsewhere.'
  [...]
[/code]

So far [b]City Game Studio[/b] can [b]create[/b], [b]update[/b], [b]delete[/b], [b]validate[/b] and [b]download[/b] mods.
Since I'm a solo developer I went deeper and I added a Mod API version to City Game Studio. The version number is automatically added when you create a new Mod. In case a mod uses an older version of the Mod API, it will be automatically disabled to avoid data corruption or crashes.
It means that City Game Studio downloads/validates a mod when you create/update one, but also when ou enable one. I think it is more convenient that way, because you won't have to deal with mods compatibility.

[h2]Is it ready yet?[/h2]
Not yet but soon. So far I have integrated 4 of the 10 schemas.
[table][tr]
  [th]Schema[/th]
  [th]State[/th]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Rename/Add platform[/td]
  [td]DONE[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Rename/Add manufacturer[/td]
  [td]DONE[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Rename/Add competitor[/td]
  [td]DONE[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add theme[/td]
  [td]DONE[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add InApp-Purchase[/td]
  [td]TO DO[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add marketing campaign[/td]
  [td]TO DO[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add furniture[/td]
  [td]TO DO[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add custom difficulty[/td]
  [td]TO DO[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add feature to the digital store[/td]
  [td]TO DO[/td]
[/tr][tr]
  [td]Add feature to the game engine[/td]
  [td]TO DO[/td]
[/tr][/table]

[h2]How do I make a mod?[/h2]
[b]It is not yet implemented[/b] A page of https://www.city-game-studio.com/ will be dedicated to that.
Let's take an example. You want to rename a platform. So you open the website, go to the Mod creator, and click on [b]Rename platform[/b].
Then you select the platform, enter its new name (you can also change the manufacturer). Once done, you download a zip file. Then you launch [b]City Game Studio[/b], click on [b]Mod[/b], select the zip file and you are good to go.

[u]Note:[/u]
Zip file contains clear text, so if you want to create mod manually you will be able to do so.

[h2]Closing words[/h2]
I'm thrilled about the Mod support, and I think you will be able to make mods manually by the end of October. I wish I could release it sooner, I'm sorry about that delay.
Indeed I had several mandatory appointments that I couldn't skip, plus I wanted to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061550/Sneak_In_a_zuma_game]Sneak In[/url] on Steam just after the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamgamefestival]Steam Game Festival[/url]

Thank you for your time
Regards
Binogure

notes.title: 1983 crash, negotiations with console manufacturers
notes.content:
Hello world!

4 months have passed since the last update, and I apologize for the delay.
Usually I publish one major update per month or every two months on average.
However these last months have not been like the others, for those who follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/binogure]Twitter[/url] or who are on the [url=https://discord.gg/citygamestudio]Discord[/url] server, as you already know, I've moved to another country. that is why the development of [b]City Game Studio[/b] slowed down.

The good news is that I was able to resume the development. Well it's end-of July already, and as promised here is the 0.31.0 update. So today on the menu we have...

[h2]Negotiating with the manufacturers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/090147c56b398a16261ebf77e58082b065bc70a7.gif[/img]
Previously unlocking a game console was straightforward. Simply click on the console and it was all done. From now on, you'll have to negotiate with the manufacturer. The more you work with a manufacturer, the easier the negotiations will be. Of course, the opposite is also true.

[h2]The crash of 1983[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/a6332b2c3f1785e7768c87ec3494d00019af6650.gif[/img]
The first few years in City Game Studio are incredibly easy. To reflect reality, I introduced the video game crisis of 1983. It impacts the first two generations of consoles, which means that from 1983 on, to make profit you'd have to negotiate with a manufacturer.

The 1983 crash has no exact date, it can start in January as well as in December. This suggestion made by [u]Zarys[/u] helps to extend the life of the game.

[h2]Developing games on upcoming consoles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/bf948e721a5616b58bce1aa07acd88790becbfef.gif[/img]
Many of you have requested this feature, and now you can develop games for consoles that are not yet available. This involves negotiating with console manufacturers, and it makes City Game Studio much more lively.

[h2]Choose the release date[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/1eaf9f3ac1f36df06b5c3bafdb91befa965e2b55.gif[/img]
This is another request from the community. And from now on you will be able to choose when to publish a game. This comes in handy when you want to synchronize game ports. And it allows you to better manage the marketing campaign.

Now you can start porting a non-released game. However, you can develop game port only for ready games.

There are still many other changes, and for all of them you can either launch the game or read the full list of changes.

I hope you like it, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/citygamestudio]Discord[/url] to talk about it with us!

Cheers
Binogure

notes.title: Lootboxes, microtransactions and advertising
notes.content:
Good morning, everyone,

Version 0.30.0 has been deployed yesterday but I wanted to describe the biggest changes with you.

This version introduces new ways to monetize your games. You can sell your games in a conventional way, i.e. with a purchase price or a monthly subscription, and now you can make free to play games and get paid through advertising or microtransactions. The revenues are lower, but your fanbase will grow faster.

[h2]Lootboxes, microtransactions and advertising[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/0f4d79c2a7a9de5b3f276d4edc8bc8c02771b721.gif[/img]
Beside to advertising revenue, you can also add microtransactions. Three types of microtransactions are available. Cosmetics, which long-time players enjoy. New players love power boosts. And then there are the lootboxes. You decide what's in these lootboxes. You can put in power boosts as well as cosmetics.

[h2]More charts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/fbef065e3b18c3439f06b796d27557b52e28736f.gif[/img]
In order to help you make your games more profitable, a new financial details panel has appeared. It allows you to keep track of your players, but also to know how much advertising or microtransactions have brought you back.

As usual I describe here only the biggest changes, if you want to know more, you can either launch the game or read the Changelog. I hope you will like this update, and  [url=https://discord.gg/citygamestudio]join us on discord[/url] to talk about it!

Cheers
Binogure

notes.content:
Hello world!

City Game Studio is one year old. It's been released a year ago, and since then I kept working on it to deliver the best development tycoon game ever. And today, oh today, we are going to talk about the v0.29.0.

[h2]Joint studio project[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/a96d7745e7ef613cefd07a2eca7e4279e486f428.gif[/img]
Let's say you want to make a AAA game. Now, you need at least 100 employees with one producer. How can you fit 101 employees in a single studio? You can't! BUT, you can have several studios working on a single project. That's right, you can have 10 studios to work on a game, or on a game port, or on a contract, or on a digital store's feature...

[h2]Game update (DLC?)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/71db3abe4799b2edec3507f09099d7894d3f77f6.gif[/img]
So, you've published a AAA game. You are swimming in a pool of money, but you want more! Let's publish an update. Updating a game will boost sales and fans (more money indeed).

Do you want moar money?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/5bd37ec322d60efabe77ba078c142d14bc73bffb.gif[/img]
Seriously, publishing a free update is already great, but I get you. You want more, so let's talk about Paid updates. A paid update is a DLC. Publishing a DLC makes more money than an update, but your fanbase won't be any bigger. So the choice is yours.

[h2]How to boost sales of a game?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/c5f0b386273fa881f31f82d66b4265c039f464b0.gif[/img]
DISCOUNT! Discount your game of up to 95%. Nothing like discount to gather a maximum of fan around your projects!

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/6f7d901bb2dbaae55eb1a9d5d150a6fab09ad3f3.gif[/img]
The game creation panel has changed. The workload currently provides better feedback, and it is more intuitive to make a game.

Advanced games have been reworked too. You can select the [b]starting money[/b] and you can [b]randomize the game creation sliders[/b].

If you want to know all the changes, you can either read the Changelog or just launch City Game Studio and start playing.

As you can see, there is an update per month on average. I want to keep it that way because it is easier to me to balance and test the game between 2 updates.
I hope you will like this update, and  [url=https://discord.gg/citygamestudio]join us on discord[/url] to talk about it!

Cheers
Binogure

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3][list][*] Added game updates. Publishing an update improve the sales of a game, but not its score
[*] Added DLC updates. Publishing a DLC make more money regarding the amount of the original games has been sold.
[*] Added DLC/Update schedules to the HR management schedule
[*] Advanced start: You can enter the exact amount of money you want to start with
[*] Make a discount for published games
[*] Randomize games' sliders (optional)
[*] Improve online games. Can set a price and a subscription price[/list]

[h3]QOL[/h3][list][*] Store will now show everysingle items, even the locked one, so you will be able to known when the servers are becoming available

[h3]i18n[/h3][list][*] Improved zh translations (Thanks to Mochongli)
[*] Improved ru translations (Thanks to Riken and IraqLobster34)

notes.title: Competitors games engines
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone!

The 0.28.1 version is, despite its name, a [b]major version[/b].

[h2]Rent game engines[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/87a828bcff379e747a7375e6adabef286c7da1d3.gif[/img]
You can now make money thanks to your game engines or make them FOSS! (I'll let you find out what impact it has, you'll see how cool it is).
And now you can also rent your competitors' game engines! This is the little extra that should make you happy!

[h2]Better UI (another one)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/e9c7601fe281e76d0ef8330e27a43cd9eaadca62.gif[/img]
The UI has been slightly revised. Indeed with version v0.28.0, the game creation panels had been redone. To make everything consistent with the latest graphic overhaul, the rest of the game has also been revised.

[h2]Studios optimization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/9e8157a4eb2235b3e01439789e532dba37a4920d.gif[/img]
The v0.28.1 also brings a lot of optimization. Savegames are 50% lighter and loading them is ~25% faster. To this must be added the studios optimization. Large studios tended to be CPU intensive, so after a lot of work, even the largest studios should no longer blow your fans.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Game engine[/h3][list][*] Manage the game engine calendar for staff

notes.title: Custom game engines v0.28.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone

I'm glad to announce the v0.28.0 of city Game Studio. It includes Game engines, a new UI and yes, this is City Game Studio!

[h1]Create and upgrade game engines!![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/ec8264cbd6e5addf8b2b0691683be31813cb7a5d.gif[/img]
Customize your games, create a pixel art game and release it on VBox! Players are going to calibrate their joystick for the next Fighting game you are going to create!

You've created your first game engine but there is a... a ... a new technology already available... No problem, just update it, there is no need to create a new one. Unless it is an old game engine, in that case, you'd rather create a new game engine than update the old one (legacy code shhhh).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/e4e395dd986bd5bf13cad7c674cd0382dc09cae9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/f6ab47afa326dc0b492027bbb94e6d2f56be7539.gif[/img]

Each platform has its own specifications. There is no way to port a VBox game to a Handboy console. The handboy cannot handle the load of a VBox game! So to help you port your games, I reworked the game port creation panel. 

[h1]A snowy City?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/b322a4552bd3f9d77e90f133978b2b1afd900eca.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019566/fbcd53dfb26ce3af527d63ad6d93b4618a6282cb.gif[/img]

Oh, did I forget to tell you?! We went to the Montreal's Dreamhack and it was awesome!
Many of you have tested City Game Studio, and I'm glad because I got a lot of feedbacks.

notes.title: Early Access v0.23.0 The BIG update
notes.content:

This is the [b]biggest update[/b] since [b]City Game Studio[/b] has been released. [b]Gauges[/b] have been [b]improved[/b], and it is more clear how to handle them. Also you can now [b]rename convention centre[/b] and [b]filter emails[/b].

I've been working on many aspect of the game. However I spent a lot of time [b]optimizing City Game Studio[/b]. The game [b]run smoothly[/b] on a 2015 laptop (without graphic card).

notes.title: Early Access v0.18.4 EMPLOYEE UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/94cca12661dc31801e4a7c6b016d32c4c3183f7e.png[/img]

[b]Greetings everyone![/b]

It's been 3 months since we released City Game Studio in Early Access.
During those months we kept working on City Game Studio, fixing bugs, adding new game genre, new themes, new features...

Finally today we release the [b]Employee update[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/c0fd4a8ad1c67c4ffdafd9b399ae53d5ad3949a9.gif[/img]

Want to save on taxes? Want to boost your game's hype? Want to produce more?
No problem, let's hire an accountant, a marketing manager and a producer!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/f7f2d1cc0d944b94567cfd5da8505971ed80e7a2.gif[/img]

What about the studios? People who are working on other stuff, such as game ports, contracts or even post-mortems?
A human manager will help you manage your employees and will boost their happiness!

That's all for today!
Thank you all,
Binogure

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
[url=https://github.com/binogure-studio/city-game-studio-i18n]Join the community[/url], and come help us improving translations for City Game Studio
[list]
[*] Improve i18n integration
[/list]

[h1]Feature[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rework main menu
[*] Improve multi-resolution compatibility
[*] Create a new tutorial for human resources (to unlock the button)
[*] Generate competitor staff with specialists
[*] Auto-generate computers when buying a competitor
[*] Update competitor panels (poaching employees...)
[*] Add tutoriels informations for employee specialties
[*] Rework the studio manager panel (which includes employee specialties)
[*] Attach producer/accountant/marketing manager and network administrator to the game mechanic computations
[*] Add producer role to game creation
[*] Add network administrator to game creation
[*] Add accountant role to game creation
[*] Add marketing manager role to game creation
[*] Rework the employee panel
[*] Rework the recruitment panel
[*] Rework the assignation panel
[*] Balance the competitors employees
[*] Add new employee roles
[*] Generate new employee roles (to be recruited)
[*] Rework the staff panel to take into account the new employee roles.
[*] Remove shaders from the main menu, Low configuraiton should get a +10FPS on average
[*] Switch between studios directly from the menu with nice animations for the city map
[*] Added buttons to upgrades computer to the menu
[*] Added buttons to upgrade servers to the menu
[*] Added buttons to send your staff on vacation to the menu
[*] Added buttons to auto-assign staff to the menu
[*] Can rename a studio from the menu directlry
[*] Rework the game menu, new icons and between split between city map and studio icons
[/list]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Assets are flickering
[*] Make compatible old savegames with latest version
[*] Improve tooltip for employee roles (decal)
[*] Issue with competitors (cannot load them properly)
[*] Issue with old save games (cannot list employees)
[*] Issue with old save games (cannot list recruits)
[*] Competitors don't generate new games
[*] Issue with custom resolutions
[*] Issue with magazines reviews (i18n fr)
[*] Some assets are blurry (higher assets definitions)
[*] Cannot list all the saved games
[*] Loading then starting a new game might lead to a crash
[*] Rework the audio driver for windows (no more random popup about sound for windows)
[/list]

[h1]Known issue[/h1]
[list]
[*] With surround system audio is crackling (Windows only): Launch the game in Surround mode
[/list]

notes.title: Release scheduled for october 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/38d5edc9505d477caefc1b16499f61e311716547.png[/img]

[h1]Why City Game Studio has been delayed?[/h1]

Just like you we cannot wait for the release of City Game Studio. Nonetheless, releasing City Game Studio too early would imply cutting out features and rushing tests. We want City Game Studio to be a rich game with an infinite lifetime. We want to optimize City Game Studio, to improve your game experience and we want you to love playing City Game Studio.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/d4bf28723d32cfee475783e2b6af029967c15af3.png[/img] City Game Studio started as side project, one standing man making all of the development, assets, marketing, website... It was fun, but then you guys went crazy and over a thousand players started to follow the game development, asking for features and news. With that hype, we decided to give Binogure Studio a better structure, and it takes time.

[h1]Will there be early access?[/h1]

We don't want to deliver a non-finished game, so we'd better provide a closed beta than releasing an early access game. Mainly because a closed beta offers you a more complete game, bugs included ;-) Each line of code, each asset have been made with the right amount of love. We want City Game Studio to be an outstanding game!

[h1]Will there be other delays?[/h1]

We work, and we work hard to be able to release City Game Studio on time. Starting next week, we will be two fulltime employees at Binogure Studio. However, as we live without subsidies, we regularly accept subcontracts. This impacts the game development, still, it pays the bills. An alternative would be to raise funds with a crowdfunding campaign, and we would like hearing your thoughts on this. Feel free to express yourself in the comments.

[h1]What has happened since February 2018?[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/08a988cfbe59e6d39683fcd83a9615e81bb9f590.png[/img]

Back to February 2018, we had to step back, having a big picture of what we were doing then. It's hard to be objective and to keep a critical mind working alone on a project. Working and releasing [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.binogurestudio.sneakin]Sneak In[/url], a free puzzle game for android mobile phone, helped us solving this issue. Even though this decision has slowed down the development of City Game Studio for a while, it allowed us to put our finger on our weak points and to improve ourselves. Now we are excited to work on City Game Studio again!We also have submitted Sneak In to a contest offered by Lotto Quebec as part of Quebec's independent video games, and we are proud to announce that Binogure Studio has been invited to [url=https://www.montrealcomiccon.com/en/attractions/indie-game-zone/]the Montreal's Comiccon[/url] which will take place from July 6th to 8th, 2018.

[h1]Finally[/h1]

Thank you for being so many to follow City Game Studio, we are looking forward to sharing the fruit of our labour with you.

notes.title: December development update
notes.content:
Greetings fellow gamers,

I hope you are enjoying your soon-coming holidays, because I won't.
I'm working hard to produce a very polished game and I want to tease you a bit about the latest changes

[h1]Art direction[/h1]

Many things have changed since the first publication of the store page. Thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/wlazinski_m]W.i Matthieu[/url] the global art direction of the game is now on tracks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/33a02948e3600b003172546431ef0e8e02ce299b.png[/img]

As you can see on the above picture, I use now a proper color palette. And the UI is now [i]flat[/i] and [i]materialized[/i]

[h1]Animations[/h1]

Its hard to say if a developer is working or if is just playing piano. At least he is working hard to produce your games

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/d2b461d1bdcfd9058a1ee26bb59653921c6f705f.gif[/img]

There are many character customization, and now you can play as a woman.

[h1]Studio customization[/h1]

Since it is a sandbox game, I though it would be great to be able to customize a bit our studios. I drew few assets to customize your studio.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/e1de2ae08c27931e8fd293a03d2192bc8dfabf44.gif[/img]

If you guys like what I've done so far about the studio customization, please say it to, and I will draw more models.

[h1]Computer upgrades[/h1]

Now you have to manage your hardware. Upgrading your computers will improve the efficiency of your staff

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/890a2ef4676b50cba06b5c6c363b96809e9ecd54.gif[/img]

I've done many others things, such as Steam integration. So if you guys are interested to beta test City Game Studio, follow me on twitter to stay tuned about the game updates !

[url=https://twitter.com/Binogure][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019566/8313b3fcbec7ea0dc4a46625a316f301af92657d.png[/img]Follow us on twitter[/url]
